stories.title: Il fuoco, le fiamme: raid russo su un autobus a Kramatorsk, 12 morti

en.title: Fire, flames: Russian raid on a bus in Kramatorsk, 12 dead
en.summary: Russian forces attacked a bus in Kramatorsk, Donetsk region, killing 12 people according to local authorities.

stories.title: Melonellum, la legge elettorale dei paradossi: meno donne, poche preferenze, stabilità incerta

en.title: Melonellum, the electoral law of paradoxes: fewer women, few preferences, uncertain stability
en.summary: Italy's electoral reform contains apparent contradictions and constitutionally questionable provisions, despite Meloni's earlier support for gender parity measures.

stories.title: Kiev, 'raid russo su un autobus a Kramatorsk, 12 morti'

en.title: Kiev, 'Russian raid on a bus in Kramatorsk, 12 dead'
en.summary: Local authorities report a Russian attack on a bus in Kramatorsk that killed 12 people and injured 14 others.

stories.title: Aggressione Davide Iacopini, spunta la quarta vittima della banda della minicar

en.title: Davide Iacopini Assault, Fourth Victim of Mini-Car Gang Emerges
en.summary: An Italian man living in Paris who was visiting Rome has been identified as a fourth victim of an organized assault gang. According to his sister, the attackers' vehicle had a covered license plate and included an occupant aged 16 to 18.

stories.title: Legge elettorale, il voto in diretta alla Camera: oggi l’approvazione definitiva a scrutinio segreto

en.title: Electoral Law, Chamber Vote in Direct Session: Final Approval Today by Secret Ballot
en.summary: The Chamber is prepared to hold a final vote on electoral law changes through secret ballot today. Prime Minister Meloni expressed confidence while tensions remain elevated within the governing coalition.

stories.title: Ancora in rosso le borse europee, salgono spread e rendimenti BTP

en.title: European Stock Exchanges Still in Red, Spreads and BTP Yields Rise
en.summary: European stock markets opened with losses across major exchanges, with Milan declining 1.2% and Madrid 1.1%. Frankfurt and Paris fell approximately 0.9%, while London dropped 0.7%.

stories.title: Le Borse oggi, 8 ottobre. Listini in rosso tra petrolio e spread. Le banche pesano a Piazza Affari

en.title: Stock Markets Today, October 8. Indices in Red Amid Oil and Spreads. Banks Weigh on Milan Exchange
en.summary: European stock markets traded lower amid rising oil prices and government bond yield pressures. Natural gas prices in Amsterdam climbed above 80 euros per megawatt-hour while sovereign debt yields remained elevated.

stories.title: Nuova legge elettorale, oggi il voto definitivo alla Camera: Meloni alla prova dello scrutinio segreto

en.title: New electoral law, today's final vote in Chamber: Meloni facing secret ballot test
en.summary: Italian parliament held final voting on a new electoral law with secret balloting, which posed uncertainty for the governing majority over potential defections.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina - Russia, le news di oggi. Raid russo su due autobus a Kramatorsk, 30 morti e 14 feriti

en.title: Ukraine-Russia war, today's news. Russian raid on two buses in Kramatorsk, 30 dead and 14 injured
en.summary: A Russian attack on buses in Kramatorsk killed 30 people. Officials stated no date has been set for talks between Trump and Putin, with concerns expressed about conflict expansion.

stories.title: Raid russo su due autobus a Kramatorsk, 30 morti

en.title: Russian raid on two buses in Kramatorsk, 30 dead
en.summary: Russian strikes on Ukraine continued with an attack on buses in Kramatorsk killing 30 people and wounding 18 others, according to regional prosecutors.

stories.title: Roma, grave l’attore Iacopini aggredito dalla banda della minicar: l'ipotesi della challange social

en.title: Rome, actor Iacopini seriously injured in mini-car gang assault: social challenge hypothesis
en.summary: An actor was seriously injured while riding a scooter in an assault attributed to an organized group, with authorities investigating a possible social media challenge connection.

stories.title: Intesa Sanpaolo stanzia 20 miliardi per le Pmi del terziario

en.title: Intesa Sanpaolo allocates 20 billion for tertiary sector SMEs
en.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo has announced a 20 billion euro funding plan for small and medium-sized enterprises in the tertiary sector through its territorial banking division.

stories.title: La classifica delle migliori aziende dove lavorare: nella top 100 Chiesi e Bending Spoons

en.title: Ranking of best companies to work for: Chiesi and Bending Spoons in top 100
en.summary: Hilton leads the Great Place to Work ranking, followed by AbbVie and DHL. The top-performing sectors include IT, financial services, insurance, and professional services.

stories.title: Data center, in Italia sono 262: capacità raddoppiata dal 2020

en.title: Data centers in Italy number 262: capacity doubled since 2020
en.summary: Italy has 262 data centers with approximately 45 percent located in Lombardy. The installed capacity reached 609 MW at the end of 2025, more than double the 2020 level.

stories.title: La Volkswagen blinda Ducati: «Nessuna vendita nei prossimi tre anni»

en.title: Volkswagen secures Ducati: "No sale in the next three years"
en.summary: Volkswagen has confirmed it will retain ownership of Ducati for at least the next three years, ending speculation about a potential Italian return of the motorcycle manufacturer.

stories.title: «Estendere anche ai fasteners il Made in Eu»

en.title: Extend Made in EU to fasteners as well
en.summary: The European Industrial Fasteners Institute is requesting that EU authorities expand the Made in EU framework beyond automobiles to include fastening systems and other industrial sectors.
